The upper-left 81 is lighter/thinner archive foliation by another unnamed hand. No author page number or printed number is visible. Formula (34) is written in the author’s hand.

Page begins with ou de façon équivalente as a continuation. It ends with par une VA ou ext. d’icelle, and an actual comma. H’s introductory and closing editorial notes are not source text; their claims about adjacent pages were not checked.

The large vertical left stroke is an emphasis mark, rendered in TikZ. It begins beside on peut and ends around y1052, before the two lower lines ending pour le moment. H’s prose description extends it too far.

Synopsis: the author envisages explicit cocycle formulas from arithmetic properties of the individual point x, while saying the work has scarcely begun. He recalls uniqueness via Mordell–Weil and says that the abelianized cohomology class already suffices. He proposes first computing these abelianized classes, reducing the question to an abelian variety or an extension. The oblique note adds a partly unreadable qualification.

No mathematical proof, re-proof, computation or certificate was performed on this page. The uniqueness claim, sufficiency of abelianization and reduction to a VA are transcribed claims only. In particular, no assumptions about the base field or injectivity of a Kummer map were silently added. check_events is therefore empty.
